brief:
Israeli settlers attacked a U.S. journalist and activists in Hebron this week as the city remained under lockdown, Zeteo reported. The lockdown has displaced thousands of residents from their homes.

The incident occurred amid ongoing Israeli military operations and settler violence in the occupied West Bank. Journalists and human rights monitors documenting conditions in Palestinian areas face regular security threats from settlers and military personnel.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Settlers attack U.S. journalist and activists in Hebron amid mass displacement
